notes: The strongest assertions here read the sandbox git history and the recorded gh calls rather than the agent's summary, because this skill's failure mode is reporting work it did not do. Whether a branch exists, whether commits landed one per scenario, and whether a draft PR was attempted with the right title are all facts on disk. The grooming gate is the most valuable eval in the suite: a skill that implements an ungroomed issue anyway has skipped its own stop condition, and that is mechanically checkable (no branch, no commits, no PR). The fixture repo runs `node --test`, which works offline, so the test-suite step is genuinely executable.

evals.name: blocks-on-unchecked-grooming
evals.expected_output: Step 2 finds all three grooming checklist items unchecked and the implementer sections still reading _Pending grooming._, so the skill stops and reports which items are outstanding, telling the developer to complete grooming first. It creates no branch, writes no code, makes no commit, and opens no PR.

assertions.text: Stops at the grooming gate and reports the unchecked checklist items
Creates no feature branch, still sitting on main
Makes no commit beyond the fixture's own
Writes no production code: the source files are untouched
Attempts no pull request

evals.name: implements-groomed-issue
evals.expected_output: The grooming checklist is fully checked, so the skill proceeds: it reads the referenced pattern file, creates a branch named <type>/<kebab-description>, works the two acceptance criteria scenarios in order committing after each, adds the additional boundary test scenario, runs the test suite, and opens a draft PR whose title matches the issue title verbatim and whose body closes issue 55. It respects the hard constraints: no new dependency and no change to the listAssignments signature.

assertions.text: Creates a branch named <type>/<kebab-description>, following the convention in CLAUDE.md
Lands more than one commit, rather than squashing all the work into a single change
Commit subjects follow <type>(<scope>): <message> with the scope in backticks
Records lateness on the submission per the data model, comparing submittedAt against the assignment due date
Treats a submission exactly at the due date as on time, the boundary the additional test scenario specifies
Adds tests covering the new behaviour
The project's test suite passes against the finished branch
Honours the hard constraint against adding a dependency
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open('sandbox/package.json')); sys.exit(0 if not d.get('dependencies') and not d.get('devDependencies') else 1)"

assertions.text: Honours the hard constraint against changing the listAssignments signature
Attempts a draft pull request
assertions.script: grep '"pr create"' gh-calls.jsonl | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]; sys.exit(0 if rows and rows[0]['draft'] else 1)"

assertions.text: The PR title matches the issue title verbatim, it being the squash-merge commit message
assertions.script: grep '"pr create"' gh-calls.jsonl | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]; sys.exit(0 if rows and rows[0].get('title')=='feat(\`submissions\`): flag submissions made after the due date as late' else 1)"

assertions.text: The PR body closes issue 55, linking the work back to the issue
assertions.script: grep '"pr create"' gh-calls.jsonl | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]; sys.exit(0 if rows and 'Closes #55' in (rows[0].get('body') or '') else 1)"

assertions.text: The PR carries the skill:implement-issue usage label

evals.name: gh-absent-asks-for-paste
evals.expected_output: An issue number was given but gh is not installed, so the skill cannot fetch it. Rather than guessing at the issue contents or implementing something plausible, it asks the user to paste the issue body, and creates no branch or code in the meantime. Inventing an issue here would be the worst possible failure, since the work would look complete and address nothing.

assertions.text: Asks the user to paste the issue body, gh being unavailable
Does not invent issue contents and implement against them
Creates no branch while waiting for the issue body
Writes no production code
